places.name: The Amber Temple
places.when: flag.tsolenka_gate_open or flag.kasimir_sister_told or guest:kasimir_velikov or tarokka.tome.region == amber_temple or tarokka.symbol.region == amber_temple or tarokka.sword.region == amber_temple
places.summary: A temple cut into the ice high above the Tsolenka Pass, its doors watched by colossi of amber. The things sealed inside it talk, and bargain.
